en.topic_title: Hong Kong police launch AI-powered national security platform for school pupils
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong police have launched an artificial intelligence-powered national security education platform for pupils.



Hong Kong police launch an AI-powered national security education platform for the city’s pupils during a ceremony on October 6, 2026. Photo: HKPF, via Facebook.



The NSmarties AI Interactive Platform was officially launched last week at a ceremony at Precious Blood Primary School in Ap Lei Chau, with about 700 pupils attending, police said in a social media post.
